candidates.preflight: One-clip smoke inference succeeded on the frozen 35-clip manifest; both encoder and decoder report CoreMLExecutionProvider with CPUExecutionProvider fallback. Non-empty output returned. This is compatibility only, not a scored benchmark result.

limitations: FLEURS is read speech based on parallel sentences, not spontaneous phone conversation.
The subset contains 35 clips; repeated runs do not increase clip coverage.
Individual one-clip smoke timings are compatibility diagnostics and must not be compared or reported as model performance.
CPU/RSS and MPS allocation are process-level standalone measurements sampled every 0.5 seconds; short-lived peaks between samples may be missed, and no classifier is loaded.
